name: Cloth
notes: fact: Pires dates the return of the Coromandel traders to October, and Araújo gives April and September for Bengal arrival and departure (docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md §2; Pires II, p. 272; Cartas III, p. 10).
inference: Separate Gujarat, Bengal and Coromandel calls can replenish different cloths; one index combines them for play (docs/research/prices.md §§3–5; docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md §§1–2).
gameplay: Base index from docs/research/prices.md §5; the monthly and stock percentages are tuning values, not historical prices or rates.
